coot.who: skinny old backwoods moonshiner, a gaunt elderly hillbilly
coot.design: battered olive-brown wide-brim felt hat with a round crown, a long pointed snow-white beard reaching his chest, white bushy sideburns and moustache, big bulbous red nose, rust-brown work shirt with a few dark buttons and patches, a worn dark leather belt, baggy grey-olive trousers with a tan patch on the left knee, scuffed dark brown boots, thin bony arms with bare weathered forearms

coot.texture: old hillbilly, olive-brown felt hat, long white beard, red nose, rust brown shirt, grey olive trousers with tan knee patch, dark brown boots, empty hands, no weapon

yard_deputy.texture: rural sheriff's deputy, black hat, black moustache, tan khaki uniform shirt with pockets and brown buttons, gold star badge, brown duty belt, charcoal grey trousers, black boots, tanned skin, empty hands, no weapon

maw.who: giant alien matriarch, the Alien Sheriff's mother, a towering grey alien housewife who runs the mothership like a trailer-park kitchen
maw.design: a big smooth grey-green alien head shaped like a dome, two huge glossy black bug eyes with glowing red irises, bright red lipstick on a small mouth, exactly TWO thin straight grey antennae standing up from the top of her head, one on the left and one on the right, symmetrical like a V, each ending in a round glowing green ball, a row of pink plastic hair rollers and silver tin curlers set in a ring on the top of her bald dome under a brown hairnet, the sides of her smooth grey head and her face bare, pink cat-eye glasses with little rhinestones hanging on a beaded chain under her chin, a pear-shaped body with wide hips in a knee-length quilted pink and dusty-rose plaid housecoat with big puffed shoulders, a ruffled cream collar, ruffled cream cuffs at the elbows, two front pockets and a white hanky poking out of the right pocket, thin bare grey-green alien forearms and long grey four-fingered hands, thin grey legs below the hem, and fluffy pink slippers with big pink pompoms
maw.face: a scolding, put-upon mother's glare, lips pursed, one antenna bent, the look of a mom about to swat somebody with a rolling pin
maw.texture: giant grey-green alien mother, black bug eyes with red irises, red lipstick, antennae with green glowing tips, pink and silver hair curlers under a brown hairnet, pink cat-eye glasses on a chain, pink plaid quilted housecoat with cream ruffled collar and cuffs, grey-green arms and legs, fluffy pink slippers with pompoms, empty hands

maw_bare.who: giant alien matriarch, the Alien Sheriff's mother, a towering grey alien whose burning housecoat has fallen away to show the battle girdle she wore under it
maw_bare.design: she MUST have her two antennae: exactly two thin grey antennae, each about half as tall as her head, standing up out of the top of her dome in a V, each tipped with a round glowing red ball; a big smooth grey-green alien head shaped like a dome with a glowing red crack across the top, two huge glossy black bug eyes with glowing red irises, bright red lipstick on a small mouth, exactly TWO thin straight grey antennae standing up from the top of her head, one on the left and one on the right, symmetrical like a V, each ending in a round glowing red ball, no hair rollers and no glasses, a big round plump pear-shaped grey-green alien body, as wide and round as her housecoat was, a heavy round belly and very wide hips, her whole torso from the armpits down to the bloomers armoured by FOUR wide riveted dull tin hoops stacked close one above the other like a barrel's staves and hoops, the chest completely covered by a tin breastplate band, only narrow grey gaps between the hoops, a ring of eight glowing green power cells set upright round the girdle at the waist, plain dark brown bloomers snug under the round belly, round tin shoulder caps, thin bare grey-green alien arms with long grey four-fingered hands, thin grey legs, and fluffy pink slippers with big pink pompoms
maw_bare.face: furious, eyes blazing red, lips pulled back, the look of a mother who has completely run out of patience
maw_bare.texture: giant grey-green alien mother, glowing red crack on her dome, black bug eyes with red irises, red lipstick, antennae with red glowing tips, riveted dull tin hoop girdle with glowing green power cells round the waist, dark brown bloomers, tin shoulder caps, grey-green arms and legs, fluffy pink slippers with pompoms, empty hands
maw_bare.extra_note: The third reference image is this same character painted before in her housecoat: keep her head shape, face, bug eyes, lips, antennae, arms, hands, legs and slippers exactly as there, but WITHOUT the housecoat, the curlers, the hairnet and the glasses: her bald grey dome bare, and the riveted tin hoop girdle with glowing green cells and the dark brown bloomers described.
